This directory contains the official browser bundle used by the homepage avatar.

- Source: https://github.com/CatsJuice/sticker-forge
- Commit: `a1b1853564651fb2fce4d8e637e751fc076066ad`
- Upstream file: `public/embed/sticker-forge.iife.js`
